content: Survey of six flagship benchmark repos via GitHub API file listings (Oct 2026): stanford-crfm/helm ships CHANGELOG.md, CITATION.bib, Apache-2.0 LICENSE, 9 GitHub Actions workflows (test-python, test-frontend, test-scenarios, publish-pypi, deploy-frontend), pre-commit, mkdocs+readthedocs, uv.lock, conftest.py, plus a documented 'Reproducing Leaderboards' procedure pinning each leaderboard release to run_entries_*.conf + schema_*.yaml files. EleutherAI/lm-evaluation-harness: MIT, tests/, unit_tests.yml CI, CITATION.bib, CODEOWNERS, task templates/ for contributors, docs. gluonfield/BEND (DNA LM benchmark): BSD-3-Clause, pyproject+requirements, docs+readthedocs, conf/ configs, examples, no tests. instadeepai/nucleotide-transformer: LICENSE.md (nonstandard), notebooks, pre-commit, docs, no tests. MAGICS-LAB/DNABERT_2: Apache-2.0, requirements.txt, README with setup/finetune/GUE-eval/BibTeX, data via Google Drive, check_build.yml CI, no tests, no CONTRIBUTING. GenBench/genbench_cbt: fullest hygiene — AUTHORS, CONTRIBUTING.md, LICENSE, Makefile, tests/, templates/, PR template, CI.
